assumptions.initial: Design mix, not extracted trial or Medicare distribution. Baseline G4 represents eGFR25-29, G2 represents60-75; subsequent stage states do not retain within-stage eligibility.
assumptions.mortality: Hypothetical common stage hazards and Gompertz age increase, not estimated from trial or USRDS. No direct mortality treatment HR. Lifetime sensitivity only.
assumptions.costs: USRDS2025 CKD6 Table6.3 diabetes Yes, age66+, 2023 PartsA/B/D: stages1-2 30908,3 34513,4-5 46557. Mapping grouped stages to individual states is assumed. Dialysis100000 is a scenario assumption, NOT a USRDS point estimate. Transplant44645 from ESRD9 Fig9.11d is average annual prevalent cost, not first-year cost.
assumptions.cost_conversion: Remove an assumed20% prescription share from all source total costs to construct background medical proxies; use assumed3% inflation annually for3years. Not a measured2026 price index. Add only intervention drug cost; common background pharmacy cost excluded. Not comprehensive US healthcare-sector spending.
assumptions.utility: CKJ2024 Table2 UK tariff values transferred as a scenario; not a US/T2D valuation.
assumptions.transitions: Published mixed-population high-UACR matrices reused conditionally, no T2D-specific calibration. Normalize rounded rows; early cycles0-3 then late. KRT rows follow published source.
assumptions.discontinuation: Reference retains source arm contrast and charges full daily exposure while pre-KRT. Additional dropout scenarios are hypothetical policy deviations: switch to comparator transitions after stop. They are NOT fitted on-treatment effects or estimates of trial adherence.
assumptions.events: HF and adverse-event effects not separately modeled. Background medical proxies already include events; no extra event savings. Treatment-burden sensitivity tests add explicit hypothetical cost/QALY penalties.
assumptions.transplant: Single average prevalent transplant state; no incident transplant operation cost added to avoid overlap. First-year/maintenance distinction unresolved and tested via cost scenarios.
assumptions.bia: Illustrative100000-member fixed-size plan,1000initial eligible and20new eligible/month, no empirical prevalence claim. Entrants are treatment-naive age65; original cohort age increases. Annual targets apply monthly among pre-KRT members; only never-treated G2-G4 can initiate, so target may be unattainable. Off-treatment never restarts. Existing users begin in late phase.5% annual exits;10% stop. Shares1 mean gross modeled components, not actual net Medicare liability. G4 new-start eligibility uses an assumed one-third fraction because the stage cannot distinguish eGFR15-24 from25-29; this is not a lab-verified rule. BIA uses late renal matrices for all members, including new starts, as a prevalent-population steady-response approximation; early dynamics are modeled only in CEA.
assumptions.psa: Scenario PSA, not empirical posterior: common lognormal cost CV20%, mortality CV30%, common utility shift SD.03, Uniform(.5,1.5) drug price and Uniform(0,1) retention of arm contrast. Renal matrices fixed; no inferred covariance from rounded marginal SEs. Report conditional acceptability, not certainty of value.
